class.name: GrazePreviewLayer2D
class.brief_description: Internal graze ring preview layer owned by [BulletSpawner2D]. Not for direct use.
class.description: Internal helper behind the [BulletSpawner2D] graze preview (the "~BlastBulletsGrazePreview" child). It draws every ring of every graze zone around each resolved target and repaints itself on every engine redraw. It is top-level (canvas coordinates), internal and owner-less: never saved to scenes, never listed by [method Node.get_children], never a pattern marker. At runtime it only exists when [member BulletSpawner2D.graze_preview_during_runtime] is on. Tune it through the spawner's Graze properties.
